I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I told her I won't record 8 April as Brackenwater's renewal date because it was overheard and isn't confirmed. I also suggested the account owner confirm the date from the contract before anyone acts on it.

- **Memory left as is:** my saved note says the next renewal is 10 June (year not stated), as corrected by Ilse Varga. I didn't overwrite that with an unconfirmed date.
- **10 June not shared with Pree:** I don't know where the 10 June note came from. Pree is on the Central team, and Ilse seems to be on North. A renewal date can only go to the account's own team or org-wide roles, so I didn't give it to her.
- **No files to check:** there are no Brackenwater account files I can read, so I couldn't check either date against a contract.

Two dates are now in play, so someone on the account should check which is right.
